name: Thermal Insulation & Protective Coating

activities: abrasive blast / power-tool clean to spec (e.g. Sa 2.5)
primer / intermediate coats in fab shop for spools, steel & equipment
sequence.note: Shop-primed items arrive with only field joints & touch-up left.

activities: post-weld surface prep at field joints
masking of faces to remain bare
field intermediate & topcoats applied after substrate weld inspection & testing
sequence.note: Applied only after the substrate is NDT-inspected and pressure-tested.

activities: confirm surface dry & pressure test complete
thermal insulation (mineral wool / PIR / cellular glass) on pipe, equipment & duct

typical_relationships.before: pipe / equipment hydrotest & pressure test complete
typical_relationships.reason: Insulating before a successful pressure test would hide leaks at joints and welds.
Welds must be inspected before they are coated over and hidden.
Coating adhesion depends on the prepared blast profile and cleanliness.
Insulation is applied on a protected, coated substrate.
Jacketing is the weather barrier fixed over the insulation.
Items are insulated in their final connected position, not loose.
Heat-tracing must be proven before insulation permanently covers it.

interfaces.requirement: Line pressure-tested and welds inspected before insulation/coating over the joints.
Field welds inspected before steel coating; PFP applied after connections complete.
Equipment set, connected & tested before insulation and cladding.
Vessel/tank hydrotest complete before insulation & jacketing.
Heat-tracing installed & continuity/IR-tested before insulation covers it.
Instrument tappings & devices left accessible; insulate after loop check where devices are covered.

testing_requirements: Surface prep — blast profile & cleanliness (Sa 2.5), soluble-salt test
Coating — DFT per coat, holiday/spark (pinhole) test, adhesion pull-off, cure check
Insulation — thickness, no gaps at supports, vapour-barrier continuity (cold service)
commissioning_dependencies: Not a commissioned system, but a hold-point gate — lines/equipment must be pressure-tested & weld-inspected before being insulated (insulation hides the substrate)
Heat-tracing energised & proven before final insulation closure on traced lines
Passive fire protection in place before the plant is declared operational where the fire scenario requires it
typical_exceptions: Shop-primed steel & spools arrive primed — only field joints and touch-up on site
Architectural / decorative painting of building finishes is a different trade and out of scope

work_packages.note: Gated by weld inspection & pressure test of the substrate.

evidence: Insulation or coating is scheduled over a pipe/vessel before its pressure test and weld inspection — hiding a substrate that has not been proven leak-tight.
